name: Transparent background v1
description: Four cases that ask for a transparent background — three stickers and one cut-out edit — scored on the alpha channel itself: how much of it is transparent, how clean the edge is, and whether the opaque part is one subject rather than a field of speckles.

eval.notes: The thresholds are per row (answer.min_transparent_fraction, answer.max_components, answer.max_ambiguous_fraction) because a sticker with three curls of steam is legitimately several components. An image with no alpha channel, or one whose alpha is uniformly opaque, fails: `transparent: true` quietly ignored is exactly what this suite exists to catch.

notes: The render shape comes from each row's meta.render, not from params: these are frozen cases, and a case rendered at another size or seed is a different picture. params carries only what is the same for all of them. A lane with no transparency parameter at all should not be run against this suite — record the gap instead of a row of zeros, since what would be measured is the API, not the model.
